summary: The Plane of Earth is the elemental dominion of stone and crystal. Its caverns, halls, and forges test mortals before they reach the Earthen Throne.
history: Formed when elemental forces claimed dominion over stone and tectonic power.
Crystal Caverns grew from primordial resonance and mineral guardians.
Stone Halls became the bastion of earthen sentinels.
Tectonic Forge formed as the crucible of elemental stonecraft.
Earthen Throne rose as the seat of the Earth Sovereign.
